_PROVENANCE.purpose: AUDIT: is HydroDenseNet v4 (SENTINEL-Lite) really imagery-only? Rebuild retrieval on the SAME S2 x in-situ pairs, station GroupKFold, imagery-only vs imagery+in-situ-pH, per-param R2 + site-clustered CI. Quantify how much of SpCond/DO R2 is driven by the in-situ pH input.
_PROVENANCE.data: data/processed/satellite/drone_wq_pairs.npz (REAL Sentinel-2 L2A B02,B03,B04,B08 x REAL same-day USGS/NWIS in-situ WQ). N=12000 tiles, 379 sites.
_PROVENANCE.model: HistGradientBoosting (CPU), same family as cycle-14 honest recipe.
_PROVENANCE.ph_note: pH feature = REAL in-situ pH-strip value (v4's FiLM input). Any gain it produces is IN-SITU-driven, NOT optical/imagery-only.

finding_1_ph_is_input.evidence: train_hydrodensenet.py: ALL_COLS=[DO,pH,Turb,Temp,SpCond]; TARGET_COLS=[DO,Turb,Temp,SpCond] (pH removed). TileDataset returns 'ph_input'; HydroDenseNet.ph_encoder->FiLMLayer at every scale (MultiScaleAggregator.films) modulates visual features; pH also concatenated into BandRatioEncoder input. => in-situ pH is consumed.
finding_1_ph_is_input.paper_claim_status: INCORRECT: paper/v4 JSON say 'imagery only / no in-situ sensors', but the model requires an in-situ pH-strip reading.

finding_2_target_norm_train_only.evidence: train_hydrodensenet.py computes target_mean/std via train_ds.compute_target_stats() on the TRAIN split only, then set_stats() shares those TRAIN stats to val/test. No test/global z-score fit -> no normalization leakage. (This audit's GBM predicts raw units, so it is independent of that path.)

spcond_regional_proxy_probe.site_mean_oracle_note: between-site ceiling: R2 achievable by predicting each site's own mean SpCond.
spcond_regional_proxy_probe.interpretation: If SpCond R2 collapses toward ~0 once the few extreme brackish/high-ion sites are removed, the positive R2 is a spurious REGIONAL proxy (telling brackish sites from fresh), not a within-freshwater conductance retrieval.

imagery_only_is_the_honest_claim.note: These are the numbers the paper's 'imagery only / no in-situ sensors' claim actually supports. Temp is genuinely optical; Turb is weak; SpCond is near/below 0 (physics limit); DO is a modest chl/temp-proxy signal.

verdict.ph_drives_spcond: In THIS GBM retrieval pH does NOT drive SpCond: SpCond imagery-only R2=0.479 vs +in-situ-pH R2=0.484, pH marginal delta=+0.004 (CI -0.021..+0.027, includes 0). So the v4 SpCond~0.44 is NOT primarily a pH-input effect; it is a SPURIOUS REGIONAL PROXY (see spcond_regional_proxy_probe).
verdict.ph_drives_do: pH DOES buy real DO R2: imagery-only 0.518 -> +pH 0.589, marginal delta=+0.071 (CI +0.047..+0.094, excludes 0, prob=1.0). This portion of v4's DO skill is IN-SITU-driven, not imagery. Honest imagery-only DO R2=0.52.
verdict.spcond_is_regional_proxy_not_optics: DECISIVE: SpCond variance is ~entirely BETWEEN-site (site-mean oracle R2=0.969). The GroupKFold R2=0.48 is achieved ONLY by ranking a few extreme brackish/high-ion sites against fresh ones. Dropping sites with mean SpCond>5000 uS/cm collapses imagery-only R2 to -22.9 (far worse than predicting the mean) and +pH to -24.0. Within freshwater there is NO optical conductance retrieval. The v4 'SpCond R2=0.44' (and the CI 0.23..0.65 with lower bound near 0) is this brackish-vs-fresh regional artifact, consistent with dissolved-ion conductance having no RGB+NIR optical signature. The old imagery-only ViT's SpCond=-0.95 simply failed to latch the brackish sites; neither number reflects genuine optical conductance skill.
verdict.paper_fix: Two corrections to §3.6 / v4 JSON: (1) 'imagery only / no in-situ sensors' is INCORRECT — the shipped model consumes an in-situ pH-strip reading via FiLM; report the imagery-only R2 (DO 0.52, Turb 0.06, Temp 0.74, SpCond regional-artifact) as the honest no-in-situ number, and if the pH-conditioned model is kept, label its numbers explicitly as using an in-situ input. (2) The SpCond R2~0.44 must not be presented as an optical conductance retrieval; it is a between-site brackish-vs-fresh proxy that collapses to strongly negative within freshwater.
